model_annotation: The image displays two side-by-side grouped vertical bar charts illustrating percentage values for three materials across three years, with the left chart titled "Deutschland" and the right chart titled "EU". In both charts, the horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered alphabetically from left to right as "Aluminium", "Kupfer", and "Nickel". The vertical axis is the value axis, labeled "%" at the top, featuring a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The bars are grouped by material, with each group containing three adjacent vertical bars representing different years, as indicated by a shared legend at the bottom: blue for "2021", purple for "2022", and light gray for "2023". Every bar is visually emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it. In the "Deutschland" chart, the Aluminium group shows values of 3.6 (blue), 2.7 (purple), and 1.0 (gray, the shortest bar in this chart); the Kupfer group displays 8.3 (blue), 11.3 (purple), and 2.2 (gray); and the Nickel group contains the tallest bars, with values of 25.1 (blue, the tallest overall in this chart), 24.7 (purple), and 11.4 (gray). In the "EU" chart, the Aluminium group has values of 3.2 (blue), 2.8 (purple), and 1.7 (gray); the Kupfer group shows 4.4 (blue), 5.1 (purple), and 1.3 (gray, the shortest bar in this chart); and the Nickel group again has the highest values, showing 24.3 (blue, the tallest overall in this chart), 23.3 (purple), and 14.6 (gray).
